pages.text: ...Do they even have a face?$(br)So creepy!$(br)Be vigilant, or they will sneak up on you.
Our scans indicate $(item)Hunters$() scour the surface level of $(item)The Midnight$(), looking for easy prey.
The crystal bugs resembles butterflys and are found in the $(item)Crystal Spires$() biome. It's drawn to $(item)Bloomcrystals$()
Roams most biomes on the surface level. Tough.$(br)But their meat probably tastes amazing. Looks kind of regal.
This cluster looking thing was found when scanning the $(item)Caves$() of the pocket dimension.
The initial scan indicate that the $(item)Caves$() contain spider nests. The spiders themselves are small, but deadly.
Found in $(item)Deceitful Bogs$() in bodies of water. A nasty little fish that will snap at your heels.
